carrier: agent passes user-controlled string to a tool whose downstream logger / formatter does reference resolution
real_world_anchors: OWASP LLM01 (Prompt Injection) — the parent class for indirect injection in agent tool args
production_recommendation: Add a per-tool JNDI rule for any string-accepting tool whose backend / logger chain is not fully under your control. The default policy catches JNDI strings in shell-tool args; extending it to non-shell tools is a 5-line PolicyRule append.
